description: Ranked discovery lists from observed Amazon buy-box data, 25 rows per page. kind=brand_movers: brands gaining (direction=up) or losing (down) distinct buy-box sellers fastest over 30 or 90 days. seller_movers: sellers whose buy-box footprint grew or shrank most. top_brands: brands ranked by buybox_days / sellers / control_score / asins / revenue / amazon_share, optionally within a root category_id. top_sellers: third-party sellers ranked by brands / buybox_days / asins / revenue (the biggest cross-brand operators). top_categories: categories ranked by asins / brands / heat / revenue / price / sellers (root categories, or the children of parent_id). Use to DISCOVER brands, sellers or categories - sourcing leads, brands under seller pressure, the biggest resellers - then drill in with evaluate_brand, seller_profile or category_metrics. Amazon marketplaces only.

category_id.description: top_brands: root category id to narrow to.

name: market_lists
